      My app

      I built my own app.

      I kept forgetting my things. So I built LastLk. It’s like FindMy, but for everything you own: smart, location-based reminders that give you one last look before you walk out.

      Every hat I wore to ship it

      1. FounderSpotted the problem: my own forgetting
      2. Product designerPlaces, items and smart reminders
      3. Brand designerThe name, the eyes, the icon
      4. iOS developerBuilt it myself in Xcode
      5. LaunchLive on the App Store
      6. MarketerBuilt in public, 500K+ views
      • 400+downloads
      • 10paying subscribers
      • 500K+organic views, building in public
